svg.data-cpu: Intel Ice Lake-D 8-core @ 1.9GHz with VROC support
svg.data-optics-qsfp-dd: 800GE QSFP-DD OpenZR+/ZR/2xLR4/2xFR4/DR8+/DR8/SR8; 400GE QSFP-DD OpenZR+/ZR/ER4/LR4/FR4/SR8/DR4/DR4+/PLR4; 200GE QSFP56 SR4/FR4; 100GE QSFP28 ZR4/ER4/SR4/LR4 (datasheet Compatible Transceiver Types). The datasheet publishes no per-port optical power budget for this platform
svg.data-optics-sfp-plus: the two management uplinks are listed only as '2 x 10G SFP+ management ports'; the datasheet's Compatible Transceiver Types block covers the QSFP-DD field alone, so no module list is published for them and none is inferred
svg.data-optics-sfp28: the datasheet lists the four ports as 1/10/25G SFP28 and its Compatible Transceiver Types block covers only the QSFP-DD field, so no module list is carried for them
svg.data-timing: Stratum 3E OCXO; SyncE; IEEE 1588v2 (Default, G.8265.1, G.8275.1, G.8275.2, SMPTE ST 2059-2), T-BC/OC, T-TC. The datasheet footnotes the whole row 'NOS integration is necessary to activate the specific feature' and marks SMPTE ST 2059-2 'Additional license is required'
svg.data-forwarding: segment routing, SRv6, MPLS, advanced QoS, MACsec point-to-point, a large built-in TCAM and hardware-based forwarding with streaming telemetry (datasheet KEY BENEFITS and KEY FEATURES)
svg.data-console: 1x RJ45 RS-232 and 1x micro-USB, both labelled IOIOI
svg.data-oob-sfp: 2x 10G SFP+ management ports, numbered 0 and 1 under an Ethernet-icon bracket, separate from the 32-35 SFP28 traffic ports
svg.data-timing-inputs: 1x 1PPS input/output SMB and 1x 10MHz input/output SMB; the datasheet's Compatible Timing Cable Types names '50 ohms SMB coaxial cable with 10-32UNF-2A connector' for both
svg.data-emc: FCC Part 15 Subpart B Class A; ICES-003 Class A; EN 55032 Class A; EN 300 386; EN 55035; VCCI CISPR 32 Class A

g.data-description: the earth symbol printed under the yellow REMOVE LABEL FOR SYSTEM GROUNDING sticker. No grounding lug or two-hole pad is visible on the rear render; with no hardware installation guide there is no stated lug location for this chassis
g.title: ground-rear

circle.data-description: HIG Fan FRU LED table - Off (no input power), Solid Green (fan is functioning normal), Solid Yellow (fan is abnormal, service is required)
